# Chronoflow — Implementation & Design Notes

- **Source**: ColorLib Calendar 12 (`https://colorlib.com/wp/template/calendar-12/`)
- **App Directory**: `apps/chronoflow`
- **Package Name**: `@free-react-templates/chronoflow`

## Structure & Sections

1. **Header / Navbar**: Minimal brand title & navigation.
2. **Hero / Main Card**: Centered modern scheduling card with a "Pick A Date" interactive input and calendar popup.
3. **Details Section**: Feature highlights of the scheduling assistant.
4. **Footer**: Clean attribution linking to `https://www.componentdock.com/`.

## Fidelity Notes

- Replicates the minimalist date picker widget from Calendar 12.
- Uses Roboto font via Google Fonts.
- Uses clean box-shadows and indigo accent tones.
